$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support; ignored by Force Org

tags.description: keywords and sub-types, matched by `tag:` references and profile filters; free text, though when the game defines `subTypes` a tag that matches none is a warning

modelCount.description: models in the unit as bought for its `cost`; with `composition`, the sum over its blocks of `min` × models per copy

additionalModels.description: up to `max` more models at `cost` each, of no particular profile; not used with `composition`

composition.description: how many models of each profile the unit holds and how it grows, as blocks of models bought together; replaces `additionalModels`

id.description: needed for upgrades, default gear and sub-faction rules to point at the profile

template.description: a unit stat template id from the game

stats.description: stat id → value, checked against the template

type.description: replaces the unit's type for this profile

tags.description: added to the unit's tags for this profile (e.g. Sergeant)

traits.description: added to the unit's traits for this profile (validator 1.11.0), e.g. a Shield trait only the shield-bearers have: `profile.is(trait:…)` and profile-level matching see the unit's traits plus these, and the unit counts as holding them (selector `traits`, `unit.is(trait:…)`, container `count(trait:…)`) when any of its profiles does, as with profile `tags`

swapFrom.description: each pick of any option takes `count` (default 1) of this gear off the upgrade's profile (or the unit at large), up to what is held, besides giving the option's own gear; covers options reached through a reference too, except options with their own `swaps`; not applied to the `default` option

mirrorOf.description: id of a sibling unit upgrade on another profile whose pick this upgrade always copies: the same option, never chosen by the player, with the amount set by this upgrade's own `perModel` and profile. Both must offer the same option ids (references expanded) and the same `default`; `perModel.type` must be `every` or `single`; the source can't itself have `mirrorOf`

options.description: own options and references to shared faction upgrades; when ids clash, the upgrade's own option wins, then the shared upgrade referenced first

items.description: Gear a unit carries without taking any upgrade

traits.description: the unit's traits (e.g. a faction trait), matched by `trait:` references and selector `traits` as case-insensitive text; effects may add or remove some

when.description: when the unit may be taken

limit.description: how many of this unit a scope may hold, e.g. unique characters

weapon.description: weapon profiles the equipment lets its holder use, e.g. a grenade's thrown attack (validator 2.3.0). Shown as part of the equipment, checked like a weapon's profiles; not a weapon the unit holds, so `weapon:` references, restrictions, `limitBy` and swaps never see it (they see the equipment)

additionalProperties.description: A faction-level upgrade units point at instead of repeating it

configurable.description: the rule takes a value, e.g. Ambush (X)

defaultValue.description: the value a configurable rule has when a selection gives none

grants.description: contingent resources a unit with the rule grants its contingent (negative takes some away). Expressions may use the `rule` scope, e.g. Quartermaster (X) `{ "reserve": "rule.value() - 1" }`

slots.description: slots each unit with the rule adds to its group, e.g. one filled from another faction

type.description: a group type id from the game

roles.description: units of any of these roles may fill the slot

required.description: must be filled for the list to be valid (compulsory slots)

repeat.description: the slot may be added more than once, each copy holding one unit (a team's vehicles, optional slots); `max` left out = no limit

units.description: only matching units may fill this slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are its units (any entry's, for a list of sources)

tagOptions.description: (validator 2.2.0) tag id → which of that tag's slot options this slot offers, e.g. `{ "prime": { "categories": ["honour"] } }`; each key must be one of the slot's `tags`. A tag left out offers every option

unitWhen.description: (validator 2.6.0) a condition on the unit filling the slot, checked against it as configured (its options' gear and traits included, before the group's effects) and shown as an issue while false; units are still offered by role and `units`, though an app may hide units that none of their options could make meet it. E.g. a slot of two roles that units of the second may fill only with some gear: `{ "if": "unit.is(role:officer) or unit.has(equipment:signal-array)", "message": "…" }`

units.description: only matching units may fill any slot, including slots a mechanic adds, except slots with a `source`

requirementText.description: shown when a requirement isn't met

min.description: how many of this group a list must hold, e.g. a mandatory veteran formation

max.description: how many of this group a list may hold

effects.description: applied to every unit in the group, e.g. "Every unit in this group gains the Gun Line trait"

addedSlotRoles.description: (validator 2.6.0) the only roles the `slot` effects of slot options picked in this group's slots may add: each effect's `roleChoices` is narrowed to them, and an option left with none isn't offered. `[]` = no option that adds a slot; left out, no limit

listEffects.description: (validator 2.7.0) while the group is in the list, each entry's `effects` apply to the matching units in reach, wherever they are, e.g. `[{ "units": "@vehicles", "effects": [{ "kind": "specialRule", "rule": { "id": "fearless" } }] }]`

additionalProperties.description: A selector with a name, referenced as `@id` from expressions and selector fields
A choice made for a slot with the option's tag, applying its effects to the unit in the slot (and the group), e.g. special benefits or enhancements. One option per tag per slot.
A choice made alongside an option, defined once and shared by every option that offers it

listRules.description: list rules that apply to contingents using this faction (or sub-faction), e.g. a rule about this faction's own traits

versions.description: A semver range a version must satisfy, e.g. `>=1.2.0 <2.0.0`

defaultGroup.description: the group a new list's main root group starts as when the faction is picked (its usual core formation); the faction's or the game's, of a root group type taken from the main faction

subFactionGroups.description: the independent sub-faction picks a contingent of this faction makes; sub-factions name theirs in `group`. Sub-factions without a `group` are in the `default` group (max 1), which may be declared here to name it or change its limits

__schema1.description: A record id: lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `infantry-squad` (letters a-z and digits, with single hyphens between words)

__schema6.description: A plain number, or an expression that evaluates to one

__schema8.description: An expression in the Force Org expression language (docs/specs/expression_language_spec_2026-10-17.md)

items.description: A set of models bought together: the unit holds between `min` and `max` copies of it, e.g. a Gun Crew of one Gunner and one Loader

__schema12.description: shown to players, e.g. "Gun Crew"; left out, built from the profile names

__schema15.description: unique within the unit; the key a saved list stores the number of copies under

__schema16.description: profile id → how many models of it one copy of the block holds, e.g. `{ "gunner": 1, "loader": 1 }`

__schema17.description: copies in the unit as bought for its `cost`; left out = 1

__schema19.description: most copies the unit may hold; left out = `min`. An expression (validator 1.10.0) is evaluated live for the unit as it stands, in the unit's scopes, e.g. `floor(unit.models() / 5)` on a block that `replaces` models; only a block with `replaces` may read `unit.models()`

__schema20.description: A whole number (0 or more), or an expression that evaluates to a number

__schema21.description: what each copy above `min` costs; needed when `max` is more than `min` or an expression

__schema22.description: each copy takes the place of models of `profile` in `block` instead of adding models, e.g. one Sapper upgraded to a Foreman: the unit's size stays the same and the profile's count moves to this block's profiles

block.description: the block whose models it replaces

profile.description: the profile in that block each copy takes the place of; one model of it per model in the copy

__schema28.description: the profile that takes this upgrade's gear; left out, the unit at large does

__schema30.description: id of the option picked by default

type.description: single: once for the unit or one model; multiple: any number of times; every: every model gets it; some: any number of models; one-in-x: `count` (default 1) per `everyX` models

count.description: one-in-x only: picks allowed per `everyX` models (default 1), a positive whole number; the cap is count × floor(models / everyX), e.g. `{ "type": "one-in-x", "everyX": 5, "count": 2 }` for 'for every five Models, up to two Models may each…'

excludeProfiles.description: profiles not counted as models for this upgrade

__schema32.description: Picks profiles by their type and tags (the unit's included), matched as case-insensitive text. Left out, every profile is picked.

items.description: Gear the unit must hold, optionally only counting profiles that match the filter

__schema39.description: Points at a faction weapon or piece of equipment

__schema42.description: sibling unit upgrades this upgrade takes the place of when picked

__schema44.description: caps total non-default picks at Σ count × amount of that gear held

items.description: An upgrade may be picked `count` times for each of this gear the unit has

__schema48.description: A rule's condition plus the player-facing reason shown when it isn't met

__schema50.description: id of the sub-faction unit modifier that added this upgrade

__schema51.description: a short note shown next to every gear this upgrade's picks give (validator 1.11.0), e.g. a mount: `Hull mounted`. It covers the options' `weaponRefs` / `equipmentRefs` and swap `to`s, the `default` option's and those of options reached through a reference included (the referencing upgrade's note wins over the shared upgrade's). Display only: gear is still matched, counted and swapped by kind and id

id.description: id of the option entry in the unit upgrade

target.description: id of the faction upgrade it pulls in

swaps.description: gear this option replaces, wherever the profile got it from

subChoices.description: ids of shared sub-choices made with the option, e.g. a weapon's `mount`

effects.description: applied to the unit while the option is picked, e.g. armour plating raising armour

items.description: Takes one `from` (one of each, for a list) off the upgrade's profile and gives it `to` in its place, per pick

__schema57.description: the gear taken off; a list takes one of each, and a pick needs all of them held

__schema61.description: several stat changes sharing one profile filter

items.description: `add` shifts the number and keeps its suffix: '3+' -1 → '2+', '6"' +1 → '7"'

__schema68.description: changes the special rules of the profiles `profiles` picks (all of them when left out) and the unit's own: `remove`, then `replace`, then `rule` (added). Needs at least one of the three

__schema71.description: the rule each picked profile gains

__schema72.description: (validator 2.5.0) rule ids each picked profile loses, whatever their value

__schema74.description: (validator 2.5.0) each picked profile loses any of `from` (whatever their value) and, only if it held one, gains `to`, e.g. `{ "from": ["skirmisher"], "to": { "id": "armoured", "value": "1" } }`

__schema77.description: changes the unit's traits (traits belong to the whole unit, so there is no profile filter); traits match as case-insensitive text

__schema81.description: traits the unit loses, if it has them

__schema83.description: the unit loses any of `from` and, only if it had one, gains `to`

__schema86.description: (validator 2.2.0) the slot that holds the unit counts as having these slot tags, so it offers their slot options and `slot.is(tag:…)` reads true. It tags the slot, not the unit, so there is no profile filter; in place before slot options are offered. Not allowed in a slot option's `effects`

__schema88.description: game-declared slot tags the slot holding the unit counts as having, e.g. `["prime"]`

__schema89.description: for the tags it adds, only slot options of these `category`s are offered, e.g. `["honour"]`; left out, every option of the tag. Combined with the slot's own `tagOptions` and other slotTag effects on the same tag, only options every restriction allows are offered

__schema92.description: carried by every model, so the amount follows the unit's model count

__schema94.description: with `perModel`: profiles that don't carry it

__schema95.description: the profile that carries it; left out, the unit at large does. With `perModel`: one for each model of that profile

__schema96.description: a short note shown next to this gear wherever the unit's gear is listed (validator 1.11.0), e.g. a mount: `Turret mounted`. Display only: gear is still matched, counted and swapped by kind and id

__schema100.description: a weapon stat template id from the game, e.g. `ranged` / `melee`: the template of every profile without its own `template`

template.description: a weapon stat template id from the game for this profile, in place of the weapon's `template` (validator 1.11.0), e.g. `melee` on the close-combat profile of a spear whose weapon `template` is `ranged`

stats.description: stat id → value, checked against the profile's template

items.description: A slot a mechanic adds to a group

__schema107.description: the slot's role; with several the player picks one

__schema108.description: only matching units may fill the slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are its units (any entry's, for a list of sources)

anyOf.description: A named selector by id, accepted wherever a `UnitSelector` is, e.g. `"@line-infantry"`

__schema110.description: Picks units by id, role, trait and profile type/tags; left out, a field matches every unit

__schema113.description: a unit matches when it has any of these traits, matched as case-insensitive text

__schema115.description: a unit matches when one of its profiles does (or the unit itself, if it has no profiles)

__schema116.description: (validator 2.5.0) special rule ids: a unit matches when it or one of its profiles holds any of them, with any value

__schema118.description: a unit that matches any of these does not match the selector

items.description: Units to leave out, matched like a selector (its fields all apply); e.g. `{ "profiles": { "anyOf": ["Unique"] } }` leaves out every unit with a Unique profile

__schema121.description: One faction the slot's units come from, or (validator 2.8.0) a list of them: the slot offers every entry's units, and each unit filling it may come from any entry, e.g. `[{ "faction": "field-army" }, { "faction": "clockwork-guild" }]` for "from A or B, in any combination". List each faction once. The slot's `units` applies to every entry; its `unitIds` may name any entry's units

__schema122.description: Where a slot's units come from instead of the contingent. Units keep their own records (gear, rules, upgrades) but not their home sub-faction's unit modifiers. The slot's `units` selector picks among them, seeing only each unit's own traits; the group's `units` doesn't apply

__schema123.description: a faction of the same game, possibly from another source; may be the contingent's own

__schema124.description: units of these sub-factions of `faction` may fill the slot too (`any` = every one loaded), whether or not the contingent took them; left out, only the faction's own units

__schema126.description: (validator 2.8.0) only matching units of this faction (and its listed sub-factions) may fill the slot, as well as matching the slot's own `units`; its `unitIds` are this entry's units. E.g. `{ "unitIds": ["battle-construct"] }` for "or only these units of B"

__schema129.description: applied to the unit filling the slot, after the group's effects, e.g. replacing a borrowed unit's faction trait

additionalProperties.description: Limits the slot options a slot offers for one of its tags (validator 2.2.0). Where several restrictions apply to one tag on one slot (this and slotTag effects' `categories`), only options every one of them allows are offered

__schema134.description: only slot options with one of these `category`s are offered for the tag

items.description: units the list must already hold before the group can be taken

__schema137.description: where they're counted: the group's contingent outside it (default) or its root group

items.description: applied to every unit in the group, including units in slots added later
(validator 2.7.0) Effects a group gives units outside it, e.g. "every Walker in a list with this group gains Fearless"

__schema143.description: the units `effects` apply to, seen with their own traits and sub-faction modifiers; left out = every unit in reach

__schema144.description: which units are in reach: `list` (the default) = every unit in the list, in every contingent, allies included; `contingent` = the units in the group's contingent

__schema146.description: stat, special-rule, trait and slot-tag effects

__schema147.description: applied to every matching unit in reach while the group is in the list, right after list choice values; an effect's `when` sees the unit's own slot and group, not this group's

__schema149.description: offered on slots with this tag

__schema150.description: (validator 2.2.0) what kind of option this is among its tag's, e.g. `honour`; a slot's `tagOptions` and a slotTag effect's `categories` offer only options of the categories they name

__schema151.description: only offered on slots of these roles; left out = any role

__schema153.description: only offered on slots whose unit matches, seen as it stands before slot-option effects (its traits from option and group effects included), e.g. `{ "traits": ["Field Army"] }` for an option only Field Army units may take; left out = any unit

__schema154.description: added to the cost of the unit in the slot

oneOf.description: adds a slot (or `count` slots) to the group; with several roles the player picks one
units of these roles may also fill the slot

__schema157.description: how many such slots the option adds to the group (default 1), each holding its own unit (validator 2.4.0); with several `roleChoices` the player picks one role, which all of them take, e.g. `{ "kind": "slot", "roleChoices": ["support"], "count": 3 }`

__schema160.description: (validator 2.6.0) only offered while true, seeing the unit as its `units` does; a pick whose `when` turns false is an issue. E.g. `{ "if": "group.is(group:gun-line)", "message": "Only in a Gun Line" }`

costMultiplier.description: resource id → multiplier for the option's cost, e.g. a turret mount `{ "points": 3 }`

oneOf.description: Caps what may be spent on matching units, e.g. heavy units 25%, allies 50%
Limits how many matching units (or groups) a scope may hold
Escape hatch for list rules no typed form covers. A rule only flags the list; it never prevents anything

__schema165.description: count only these units; left out = every unit

__schema166.description: count only units in contingents whose root group is one of these types

__schema178.description: `list` (default): the condition is checked once for the whole list. `group`: checked once for each group (of the listed `groupTypes`, or any) with `group`, `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list` available; the message is reported for each group that fails

__schema180.description: with `scope: "group"`: only groups of these types

additionalProperties.description: An independent sub-faction pick, e.g. a doctrine and a heritage: a contingent takes between `min` and `max` of the sub-factions in each group

__schema183.description: how many sub-factions of this group a contingent must take; left out = 0. Expressions may use `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list`

__schema184.description: how many sub-factions of this group a contingent may take; left out = 1. Expressions may use `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list`, e.g. `1 + (list.has(unit:x) ? 1 : 0)`
